# Epoch — AI Agent Time Estimation Server

> Epoch is an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server providing 24 structured tools for
> time estimation, cost analysis, and schedule risk assessment. Built for AI agents
> (Claude, GPT, Gemini) and developer workflows.

Keywords: mcp-server, time-estimation, pert, cocomo-ii, monte-carlo, cost-estimation,
sprint-forecast, token-cost, schedule-risk, ai-tools, claude-code, cursor, llm

Install: claude mcp add epoch -- npx @kyanitelabs/epoch
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@kyanitelabs/epoch
MCP Registry: https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/servers/io.github.KyaniteLabs/Epoch
GitHub: https://github.com/KyaniteLabs/Epoch

---

# Epoch — Time Estimation MCP Server

> @kyanitelabs/epoch v0.2.2 — 24 structured tools for grounded time estimation

## What

Epoch is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that gives AI agents data-driven time estimates instead of guesses. It packages established estimation methods (PERT, COCOMO II, Monte Carlo, reference class forecasting) into callable tools with built-in feedback loops for self-improvement.

## Architecture

Six layers, 24 tools:

| Layer | Tools | Purpose |
|-------|-------|---------|
| Temporal (6) | get_current_time, convert_timezone, parse_duration, time_math, add_business_days, count_business_days | Time grounding, timezone, calendar math |
| Estimation (5) | pert_estimate, cocomo_estimate, sprint_forecast, critical_path, monte_carlo_schedule | Algorithmic time/effort estimation |
| Analytics (4) | reference_class_estimate, calibrate_estimates, token_time_bridge, token_cost_estimate | Data-driven estimation from history |
| Validation (3) | cocomo_validate, cocomo_ground_truth, accuracy_trend | Model validation and accuracy tracking |
| Risk (2) | schedule_risk, compare_models | Schedule risk and model comparison |
| Feedback (4) | record_actual, get_pending_estimates, batch_record_actuals, feedback_health | Close the loop with real actuals |

## Tool Reference

### Layer 1 — Temporal

#### get_current_time
Returns current date/time in any IANA timezone.
- `timezone` (string, default "UTC") — IANA timezone identifier

#### convert_timezone
Converts an ISO-8601 timestamp to a target timezone.
- `timestamp` (string, required) — ISO-8601 timestamp
- `target_tz` (string, required) — Target IANA timezone

#### parse_duration
Parses "2h30m", "1d6h", "45m" into seconds.
- `duration_string` (string, required) — Duration string

#### time_math
Compound time operations: add_days, add_business_days, diff, convert_tz, parse_nl, format_duration.
- `operation` (string, required) — Operation name
- `operands` (object) — Operation-specific parameters

#### add_business_days
Adds N business days, skipping weekends and holidays.
- `start_date` (string, required) — ISO date
- `days` (number, required) — Business days to add
- `country` (string, default "US") — ISO-3166 country code

#### count_business_days
Counts business days between two dates.
- `start_date` (string, required) — ISO date
- `end_date` (string, required) — ISO date
- `country` (string, default "US") — ISO-3166 country code

### Layer 2 — Estimation

#### pert_estimate
PERT three-point estimation (O + 4M + P) / 6.
- `optimistic` (number, required) — Best-case duration
- `most_likely` (number, required) — Most probable duration
- `pessimistic` (number, required) — Worst-case duration
- `unit` (enum: hours|days|weeks|months, default "hours")
- Returns: expected, stdDeviation, confidence95, confidence99, urgencyCategory, feedbackToken

#### cocomo_estimate
COCOMO II with LLM-specific cost drivers.
- `kloc` (number, required) — Thousands of lines of code
- `reasoning_complexity` (number, default 1.0, range 0.5-2.0)
- `context_completeness` (number, default 1.0, range 0.5-2.0)
- `transformation_impact` (number, default 1.0, range 0.5-2.0)
- `iterative_cycles` (number, default 1.0, range 0.5-10.0)
- `human_oversight` (number, default 1.0, range 0.5-2.0)
- Returns: personMonthsNominal, personMonthsLlmAdjusted, effortMultipliers, feedbackToken

#### sprint_forecast
Sprint completion forecast from velocity history.
- `backlog_points` (number, required) — Total backlog story points
- `velocity_history` (number[], required) — Past sprint velocities
- `sprint_length_days` (number, default 14)
- `hours_per_sprint` (number, default 300)
- Returns: requiredSprints, pessimisticSprints, completionDays, feedbackToken

#### critical_path
CPM with merge-bias adjustment.
- `tasks` (array of {name, duration, predecessors}, required)
- Returns: critical_path, slack_per_task, total_duration, merge_bias_adjustment

#### monte_carlo_schedule
Monte Carlo simulation for schedule risk.
- `tasks` (array of {name, optimistic, mostLikely, pessimistic}, required)
- `iterations` (number, default 10000)
- `seed` (number, optional) — For reproducibility
- Returns: p10, p50, p80, p95, riskEvents, feedbackToken

### Layer 3 — Analytics

#### reference_class_estimate
Reference class forecasting with historical correction.
- `task_type` (enum: feature|bugfix|refactor|migration|infrastructure|documentation|testing|design, required)
- `complexity` (number 1-5, required)
- `scope` (enum: small|medium|large|xl, optional) — Inferred from complexity if omitted
- `team_id` (string, optional)
- `ai_native` (number 0.0-1.0, default 0.0) — AI-native ratio; values >= 0.7 use AI-native scope baselines
- Returns: rawEstimate, correctedEstimate, correctionFactor, sampleSize, scopeUsed, adjustedEstimate, developerProfile, feedbackToken

#### calibrate_estimates
Compute team-specific correction factors.
- `team_id` (string, required)
- `period_days` (number, default 90)
- `window_size` (number, default 5)
- Returns: correctionFactor, accuracyTrend, recommendations

#### token_time_bridge
Map token budgets to wall-clock time.
- `tokens` (number, required)
- `model` (string, required) — Model identifier
- `tool_calls` (number, default 0)
- `reasoning_depth` (enum: shallow|moderate|deep, default "moderate")
- Returns: estimatedSeconds, estimatedMinutes, confidence, breakdown, feedbackToken

#### token_cost_estimate
Token-to-time AND dollar cost estimation.
- `tokens` (number, required)
- `model` (string, required)
- `tool_calls` (number, default 0)
- `reasoning_depth` (enum, default "moderate")
- Returns: time + cost breakdown, feedbackToken

### Layer 4 — Validation

#### cocomo_validate
Validate COCOMO against 195 historical projects.
- `dataset_filter` (string[], optional) — Datasets to include

#### cocomo_ground_truth
Validate 6 COCOMO variants against 240 projects.
- `dataset_filter` (string[], optional)

#### accuracy_trend
Sliding-window accuracy tracking vs industry baseline.
- `window_size` (number, default 50)
- `team_id` (string, optional)
- Returns: windows, overallTrend, currentMape, improvementVsIndustry

### Layer 5 — Risk

#### schedule_risk
Schedule risk assessment from historical accuracy.
- `estimated_hours` (number, required)
- `task_type` (string, optional)
- `team_id` (string, optional)
- Returns: riskLevel, confidenceIntervals, recommendations

#### compare_models
Side-by-side model comparison for a token budget.
- `tokens` (number, required)
- `tool_calls` (number, default 0)
- `reasoning_depth` (enum, default "moderate")
- Returns: ranked model list with time and cost estimates

### Layer 6 — Feedback

#### record_actual
Record actual hours for a previous estimate.
- `estimate_id` (string, required) — From feedbackToken in estimate response
- `actual_hours` (number, required, must be > 0)
- `notes` (string, optional)

#### get_pending_estimates
List estimates awaiting actuals.
- `limit` (number, default 20, max 100)

#### batch_record_actuals
Bulk feedback submission (1-500 entries).
- `entries` (array of {estimate_id, actual_hours, notes?}, required)

#### feedback_health
Health report on the feedback loop.
- No parameters
- Returns: totalEstimates, totalActuals, matchRate, byTool (with mape + mdape), byTaskType (with mape + mdape), selfImprovement

## Interfaces

- **MCP**: `npx @kyanitelabs/epoch` (stdio transport)
- **CLI**: `npx epoch <command> [options]`
- **HTTP**: `http://localhost:3000/api/<tool-name>` (POST with JSON body)

## Telemetry

Epoch can optionally share anonymized estimate/actual pairs to improve accuracy for all users.
Telemetry is OFF by default. Enable with: epoch telemetry enable

What is shared: task_type, complexity, tool, estimated_hours, actual_hours, ratio, date (YYYY-MM-DD only).
What is NOT shared: project names, notes, team IDs, IP addresses, timestamps with time-of-day.

Commands:
- epoch telemetry enable -- opt in with informed consent
- epoch telemetry disable -- opt out
- epoch telemetry preview -- preview anonymized data before enabling
- epoch telemetry status -- show current config and history
- epoch telemetry set-endpoint -- configure a receiver endpoint
- epoch telemetry submit -- submit queued anonymized telemetry
- epoch telemetry export -- export all local data as anonymized JSON
- epoch telemetry delete-data -- instructions for deleting your data
- epoch share-data -- export anonymized data for community contribution

Environment variables:
- EPOCH_TELEMETRY -- set to "1" to enable, "0" to disable (overrides config file)
- EPOCH_TELEMETRY_ENDPOINT -- override the configured receiver endpoint

Privacy: docs/PRIVACY.md | Telemetry: docs/TELEMETRY.md

## Environment Variables

- `PORT` — HTTP server port (default 3000)
- `EPOCH_RATE_LIMIT` — Requests per minute (default 60)
- `EPOCH_DATA_DIR` — Data directory (default ~/.epoch)
- `EPOCH_TRUST_PROXY` — Trust x-forwarded-for header (default 0)

## Data

Reference baselines built from the packaged reference database plus user-local learned feedback. Use `epoch reference-db-status` for current provenance and `pnpm test` for the current test-suite count.
